changes.detail: Security and compliance findings in Storage Intelligence advisor are available in Preview . You can use these findings to identify buckets with objects that violate default customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) policies or enforced encryption rules, and re-encrypt the affected objects. For more information, see the following resources: About Storage Intelligence advisor Re-encrypt objects that violate default CMEK bucket policies Re-encrypt objects that violate enforced encryption rules
